purpose: Where to look up, by hand, the upstream commits recorded in analysis/freeze-provenance.json. Split out of that file because it is sealed and these URLs name their owner; see upstream.links_note there.
scope_note: Nothing in this repository reads these templates mechanically. They establish nothing on their own: what the offline checks establish is that the shipped bytes are the blobs at the commits named in freeze-provenance.json. Following a link confirms the commit TIME, which is the other half of the ordering claim.
